page.overview:
What is Opelucid City?

Opelucid City is a location introduced in Generation V.

Opelucid City features the Opelucid City Gym, where the player battles Drayden in and and Iris in . Both Gym Leaders specializes in -type Pokémon.

To the left of the Pokémon Center is a musician whose gender and instrument depends on the version you are playing. In , the musician is a male playing a Keytar. In , the musician is a female playing an Erhu.

There is a Battle House, which features a Rotation Battle against two Ace Trainers in and a Triple Battle against the same pair in . In , the Trainer on the bottom floor has Simisage, Simipour, and Simisear, in that order.
